name: flowdoro
description: Flowdoro — smart time management with proportional rest (5:1)

scripts.dev: bun run --filter '*/web' dev & bun run --filter '*/api' dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter '*/web' build && bun run --filter '*/api' build
scripts.lint: bun run --filter '*/web' lint && bun run --filter '*/api' lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*/web' typecheck && bun run --filter '*/api' typecheck
